public.usage_monthly.definition: SELECT org_id, date_trunc('month'::text, period_start::timestamp with time zone) AS month, sum(data_points_ingested) AS total_data_points, sum(bytes_ingested) AS total_bytes, max(devices_active) AS peak_devices, sum(sessions_created) AS total_sessions FROM usage GROUP BY org_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, period_start::timestamp with time zone))
public.usage_monthly.name: usage_monthly
